etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin Lacōnicus (“Spartan”), from Ancient Greek Λακωνικός (Lakōnikós, “Laconian”). Laconia was the region inhabited and ruled by the Spartans, who were known for their brevity in speech.
senses: Of speech or writing, communicative through the use of as few words as possible.
Of a speaker or writer, communicating through the use of as few words as possible.
